name: sri-venkateswara-boys-hostel
description: Sri Venkateswara Boys Hostel Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "cmd /c npm run dev:backend" "cmd /c npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cmd /c npm run build:backend && cmd /c npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: cmd /c npm install && cmd /c npm install --prefix frontend
